raw_posts.name: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
raw_posts.tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
raw_posts.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

raw_posts.name: ngram 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos
raw_posts.description: Turn ideas, documents, and recordings into narrated videos. ngram analyzes uploaded videos and screen recordings to identify key moments and build clear product walkthroughs. Create animated explainers or add an AI avatar presenter, then refine your video in chat.

raw_posts.name: Ancher 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: Turn everything you read and save into work you can ship
raw_posts.description: Ancher is an AI knowledge workspace that turns everything you read, watch, and save into work you can actually use. raw_posts.name: Hexis Cloud
